clauses.title: Scope – Gives specifications
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Gives specifications for hexagon thin nuts with metric  dimensions and thread diameters from 1.6, up to and including 10 mm and product grade B.

clauses.title: Dimensions – M1.6, M2,
clauses.text: 2. Dimensions -  M1.6, M2, M2.5, M(3.5), M4, M5, M6, M8, M10. Note -  For  details see 3 of the standard

clauses.title: Specifications
clauses.text: 3. Specifications — See Table Note — For  corresponding Indian standards of certain International standards referred, along with their degree of equivalence, refer  to National foreward of the  standard.
